title: Oxtwood's Modpack
body:
[![built with fabulously optimized](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/intergrav/devins-badges/refs/heads/v3/assets/cozy/built-with/fabulously-optimized_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized)

This modpack retains the smooth performance and visual enhancements of [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized) while adding subtle tweaks from 
[Oxtwood](https://www.twitch.tv/oxtwood) for an even more streamlined gameplay experience.

With smoother graphics, faster load times, and user-friendly features, this pack ensures an enjoyable experience without adding unnecessary complexity. Whether you prefer playing singleplayer or joining multiplayer servers.

**Key Features**
- **Performance Boost**: Enjoy faster loading times, reduced lag, and optimized frame rates with lightweight improvements.
- **Enhanced Visuals**: Built-in shaders, connected textures, and dynamic lighting make your world more vibrant, while maintaining a familiar look.
- **User-Friendly**: Features controller support, zoom options, and JEI for finding ingame recipes.
